target.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget
target.body:
Related: #95750

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators can get stuck in a gateway restart death-loop for the same wedged main session. After the gateway restarts, a persisted aborted main session can keep entering automatic restart recovery instead of being stopped once rapid accepted recovery attempts show that the session needs operator inspection.

The user-visible failure mode is repeated automatic main-session resume across gateway boots, which keeps the gateway focused on the same stuck session instead of leaving the row in a terminal state for inspection.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the durable stop-condition direction from the existing PR and makes main-session restart recovery use the same accepted-attempt fuse style as subagent recovery:

- Adds optional `SessionEntry.mainRestartRecovery` state with `automaticAttempts`, `lastAttemptAt`, `lastRunId`, `wedgedAt`, and `wedgedReason`.
- Reuses the shared `restart-recovery-fuse` helper so main-session and subagent automatic recovery evaluate the same rapid re-wedge pattern.
- Reserves the durable fuse before dispatching the gateway recovery run, then replaces the provisional idempotency key with the accepted run id.
- Rolls back the provisional fuse reservation when gateway dispatch fails before acceptance.
- Records the accepted recovery run id in `restartRecoveryRuns` for lifecycle suppression, while using `mainRestartRecovery` as the primary retry fuse.
- Keeps a legacy marker-derived attempt floor for old rows that already contain `restartRecoveryRuns` but do not yet have `mainRestartRecovery`.
- Accepted recovery run completion now persists its terminal lifecycle patch even when older recovery markers remain, so marker accounting does not leave a successfully recovered session looking `running`.
- Exhausted rows are tombstoned before another resume dispatch, clear `abortedLastRun`, and transition the session to `failed` with terminal timing fields.
- Transcript preflight/read failures do not create durable recovery state, and pre-acceptance gateway dispatch failures roll back provisional reservations.
- Existing subagent recovery state remains owned by subagent recovery; ordinary main/session progress clears stale main restart-recovery state but does not clear `subagentRecovery`.
- The existing in-process `MAX_RECOVERY_RETRIES` remains a transient startup retry/backoff guard and is not the durable cross-boot policy.

Boundaries and non-goals:

- This adds only an optional internal `SessionEntry.mainRestartRecovery` persistence field for main restart recovery. It does not add public config, wire protocol, credentials/auth behavior, provider discovery behavior, or Telegram/systemd runtime behavior.
- `restartRecoveryRuns` remains lifecycle-suppression and legacy-floor state; it is no longer the primary retry fuse for newly accepted recoveries.
- This does not add a new full Telegram/systemd/live-provider loop proof in this local environment. The PR already carries the prior Mantis Telegram Desktop gateway-run proof from the PR discussion, and this update adds issue-specific file-backed runtime coverage through the production restart-recovery entrypoint.
- Another open candidate was visible for the same issue; this update repairs the existing contributor PR and leaves final landing-path choice to maintainers.

## User Impact

Operators get a durable automatic recovery stop condition across gateway restarts. A wedged main session that rapidly re-wedges after two accepted automatic recovery dispatches is tombstoned before a third automatic resume, while deterministic transcript failures and gateway dispatch failures before acceptance do not consume the durable attempt budget.

After inspection, normal main-session progress can clear stale main restart-recovery metadata without erasing independent subagent recovery tombstones.

## Evidence

Issue-specific runtime coverage through the production main-session restart-recovery entrypoint:

```text
Validation `main-restart-recovery-precharged-main-fuse` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm vitest run src/agents/main-session-restart-recovery.test.ts
Covered: startup-orphaned main sessions record accepted attempts in mainRestartRecovery, accepted dispatches persist a provisional durable fuse before the gateway side effect, tombstone before a third rapid accepted resume, preserve accepted run markers for lifecycle suppression, apply the legacy restartRecoveryRuns floor for old rows, roll back pre-acceptance dispatch failures, and avoid charging preflight/read failures.
```

Lifecycle marker boundary:

```text
Validation `lifecycle-recovery-marker-terminal` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm vitest run src/gateway/session-lifecycle-state.test.ts
Covered: accepted recovery run completion persists terminal lifecycle state even when another recovery marker remains.
```

Touched cleanup and owner-boundary consumers:

```text
Validation `gateway-agent-recovery-cleanup` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm vitest run src/gateway/server-methods/agent.test.ts

Validation `agent-command-recovery-cleanup` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm vitest run src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts

Validation `store-normalization-main-fuse-cleanup` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm vitest run src/config/sessions/store.session-key-normalization.test.ts

Validation `command-session-store-main-fuse-cleanup` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm vitest run src/agents/command/session-store.test.ts

Validation `plugin-session-entry-slot-main-fuse` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm vitest run src/plugins/contracts/session-entry-projection.contract.test.ts
```

Static/type coverage:

```text
Validation `tsgo-core-precharged-main-fuse` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm tsgo:core

Validation `tsgo-test-precharged-main-fuse` (pass, exit_code=0)
Command: pnpm tsgo:test
```

Review finding disposition:

- Durable stop condition: main-session restart recovery now persists timestamped accepted-attempt fuse state in `mainRestartRecovery` and evaluates the same two-minute rapid re-wedge window style as subagent recovery.
- Accepted-dispatch charging: recovery dispatch first persists a provisional durable attempt keyed by the idempotency key, successful acceptance replaces it with the accepted run id and lifecycle marker, and failures before acceptance roll the reservation back.
- Startup-orphan budget: startup-orphaned rows no longer need synthetic initial markers; accepted recovery dispatches carry the durable attempt count across gateway boots.
- Legacy rows: old rows with only `restartRecoveryRuns` still get a conservative legacy floor so existing exhausted rows are not allowed to loop indefinitely.
- Accepted recovery lifecycle: accepted recovery run completion persists the terminal lifecycle patch while clearing recovery markers, instead of suppressing the terminal patch because another marker remains.
- Tombstone lifecycle: exhausted rows transition to `failed`, clear `abortedLastRun`, and stamp terminal timing fields before another resume dispatch.
- Subagent boundary: subagent recovery keeps its existing persisted owner state; main-session recovery and ordinary main/session progress do not write or clear it.
- Normal progress cleanup: ordinary user progress clears stale main restart-recovery flags through the existing cleanup path.
